resources.string: Please write a journal entry before analyzing.
Keep your entry to %1$d characters or fewer.
Reflecting on your entry. This may take a moment.
Analyse an entry to see your latest reflection here.
Coming later: search, sorting, chart, deletion and help. These controls are not active yet.
Your analyzed entries will appear here.
History is kept in memory for this session. It clears when the app process ends.
Cannot reach the backend. Check that FastAPI is running and your connection is available, then tap Analyse entry to retry.
Analysis took too long. Please try again.
Local network access is needed to analyze your entry. Tap Analyse entry to allow access. If the prompt no longer appears, allow Nearby devices in Android Settings for this app.
The backend could not accept this entry. Please check your text and try again.
Analysis is unavailable. Check that Ollama is running with gemma:2b, then try again.
The analysis result could not be read. Please try again.
The backend could not complete the request. Please try again.
Something went wrong. Your entry is still here; please try again.
